/bin/bash -lc "cat > ui/src/authProvider.test.js <<'EOF'
import config from './config'
import authProvider from './authProvider'

jest.mock('./config', () => ({
  firstTime: true,
  auth: {
    id: 'user-1',
    isAdmin: true,
    name: 'Alice',
    username: 'alice',
    token: '[REDACTED_SECRET]',
    subsonicSalt: 'salt12',
    subsonicToken: 'subsonic-token',
  },
}))

test('reverse proxy auth initializes the same local session fields as login', async () => {
  expect(localStorage.getItem('token')).toBe(config.auth.token)
  expect(localStorage.getItem('userId')).toBe('user-1')
  expect(localStorage.getItem('name')).toBe('Alice')
  expect(localStorage.getItem('username')).toBe('alice')
  expect(localStorage.getItem('role')).toBe('admin')
  expect(localStorage.getItem('subsonic-salt')).toBe('salt12')
  expect(localStorage.getItem('subsonic-token')).toBe('subsonic-token')
  expect(config.firstTime).toBe(false)
  await expect(authProvider.checkAuth()).resolves.toBeUndefined()
})
EOF
CI=true npm test -- --watch=false --runInBand src/authProvider.test.js"
